_comment: Which rules block a game and which only warn (owner decision 2026-11-07: Stake rules block, our own rules warn). Read by tools/gamedef/validate.py, tools/assets/precheck.py, tools/gates/*. Sources checked 2026-11-07; see docs/08-compliance.md Sources. Each rule's "modes" lists the factory modes it applies in (game.json release.mode, tools/gamedef/mode.py; missing release = "release"): test-mode games skip the release-only art rules.

levels.stake: Stake Engine requirement: blocks packaging (the Studio form or the review would reject it).
levels.ours: Our own quality rule or a review-rating factor: shown as a warning with the reason; you may still ship.

rules.rule: Every mode's RTP between 96.0% and 96.7%
RTP between 96.15% and 96.55% (margin inside the Stake band)
rules.why: Engine computes RTP itself; a margin avoids a measured 96.70% failing.

rules.rule: Max win at most 1,000,000x
Max win at most 100,000x
rules.why: Above it Stake's non-critical test lowers exposure and bet limits.

rules.rule: Max win realistically obtainable (more often than 1 in 10,000,000)
Cheapest mode costs 1.0x with std dev at least 0.6
Mode cost at most 50,000x
At most 20 modes
100,000 to 1,000,000 simulations per mode
No restricted social-casino words in player texts or mode names
Title avoids restricted terms (Megaways, XWays, Enhanced, Boosted, RTP, Gates of, Bonanza, Olympus, Rush, Kraken, Waylanders)
No web-sdk sample assets; assets must be unique and not infringe IP
No factory test assets (labelled placeholders) in a package
rules.why: Test placeholders are not original game art.

rules.rule: Tile (3:4) and cover (16:9) art exists
Every required art and sound slot is filled
rules.why: Unfilled slots show drawn placeholder shapes: legal, but a low review rating.

rules.rule: Each image has a recorded human edit
rules.why: Stake rates generic AI art low; a human edit also strengthens IP ownership.

rules.rule: Each file has a licence and source link
rules.why: IP defence; Stake Terms require no third-party infringement.

rules.rule: Art signed off with the current asset-set hash
rules.why: Owner review against the art-direction checklist.

rules.rule: Build at most 10 MB (textures 5, audio 2.5, JS 1.5)
rules.why: Stake's top-rating criteria: optimised bundle size.

rules.rule: Not substantially similar to an earlier game, including our own
At least 2 mechanic differences plus a signature moment
rules.why: Our way to stay clearly original; the top rating needs exceptional creativity.

rules.rule: Test skins (identity.testOnly) are never packaged
rules.why: Factory test games exist only to prove the pipeline.

modes.test: Any assets allowed (unedited AI, test placeholders); no licence, provenance, human-edit or sign-off checks and no licence output. Every Stake rule still applies; the package is a real Studio upload set.
